title: One agent step must always hit the same endpoint
prompt: The design needs a single fixed, deterministic call inside Agent Builder. What do you specify?

options.text: A custom action as the step.
options.feedback: Correct. MCP tools are not available as individual single-step selections in Agent Builder, and this requirement is deterministic execution.

options.text: An MCP tool selected as that single step.
options.feedback: Not possible. MCP tools are not available as individual single-step selections in Agent Builder.

options.text: A skill that describes the call.
options.feedback: No. Skills teach approach and reasoning; they do not perform the deterministic call.

takeaway: Use custom actions when you want precise, governed execution for a known operation.
